text:
faith: Follow-up from yesterday's postmortem for MercuryCorp (dedicated/private). Short RC: peering change during maintenance -> brief BGP flap -> on-prem NAT failover -> asymmetric return path + conntrack edge-case leading to tenant isolation. We need concrete owners, short deadlines, and a small validation drill with the customer's SRE. Prefer confirmations by EOD.

omar: I can own the peering-healthcheck and CI gating pieces. Plan: add a pre-deploy check that runs a quick BGP neighbor health script and a post-change synthetic that verifies return next-hop symmetry for a sample keyspace. Target date: 2025-03-20.

lucy: I'll coordinate the on-prem NAT failover drill with MercuryCorp SRE and collect pcaps/tcptrace. Proposed drill window: 2025-03-22 09:30 PT. Need a staging endpoint and an artifact bucket.

peter: I'll take the bug backport and a feature-flagged canary rollout. PR ETA: 2025-03-18. Rollout plan: 5% Dedicated canary for 48h, monitor peer-flaps, tail latency, and error-rate. I'll include explicit rollback steps.

faith: Staging endpoint for captures: mercury-stg-peers.int.redwood:11800. Please upload pcaps to s3://redwood-artifacts/mercury/pcaps and tag with customer:mercury incident:2001123456.

omar: Suggest alert: peer_flap_rate > 3/min that auto-annotates recent peering config pushes and notifies oncall + suspends new peering change jobs when sustained >2min. I'll open the alert PR.

ops-bot: Alert provisioned: /alerts/peer-flap-mercury (threshold=3/min). Runbook linked: /runbooks/peering-isolation-mercury.

lucy: For the drill I'll add pcap capture hooks and a short checklist for the customer's SRE: NAT failover steps, expected BGP reconvergence window, and artifact upload instructions.

peter: Quick BGP check snippet to reuse in infra libs:

```
#!/bin/bash
# bgp-peer-health.sh
vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | egrep "Neighbor|State|Last update" || exit 1
```

omar: Also proposing a small nightly synthetic that sends a probe from a Dedicated host and verifies return ASN/next-hop symmetry. If mismatch, create ticket and pause peering-change jobs for that tenant.

faith: Consolidated action items (confirm or reassign):
- omar: peering healthcheck + CI gate + nightly symmetric-path synthetic (owner:omar) / due: 2025-03-20
- lucy: on-prem NAT failover drill w/ MercuryCorp + pcaps (owner:lucy) / due: 2025-03-22
- peter: isolation bug backport + feature-flagged canary rollout + rollback steps (owner:peter) / due: 2025-03-18
- ops-bot: provision alert + annotate runbook (owner:ops-bot) / due: 2025-03-16

faith: We'll tag this recurrence pattern as "isolation-repeat-A3" in the recurring-incident tracker to correlate across Dedicated/Private tenants. I'll add rows to the remediation tracker and bring status to the next remediation sync.

omar: I'll open the infra PR and link here: https://github.com/redwood/networking/pull/2022

lucy: Confirmed the drill window with MercuryCorp SRE. I'll post the calendar invite once the artifact bucket is ready.

peter: Confirmed. I'll post the canary playbook and rollout checklist here when PR is ready.

faith: If anyone reassigns ownership, update this thread so I can keep the tracker accurate. Closing for new owners unless reassigned.
